Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Panama City Beach hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 8 of the 18 Panama City Beach hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 4, KAYAK.com at 2, Booking.com at 1 and Expedia.com at 1. These are the Panama City Beach rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 8 of the 16 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Panama City Beach hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 13% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 11% at Edgewater Beach & Golf Resort to 14% at Beachcomber Beachfront Hotel. At 7 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
